title: Over 5,000 homes without power in Kyiv after Russian strikes on energy grid
summary: Russia bombarded Ukraine with more than 300 drones and ballistic and cruise missiles in its latest nighttime attack on the Ukrainian power grid, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Tuesday. The attack knocked out heating to more than 5,600 apartment buildings in the capital, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg reports from Kyiv.
